body.statement: Every \(K\in\mathcal{P}_L\) is universally valid. The inclusion can be strict: for uniform \(\pi\) on three states and complete \(L\), the cyclic kernel \[K=\begin{pmatrix}2/3&1/3&0\\0&2/3&1/3\\1/3&0&2/3\end{pmatrix}\] is universally valid but belongs to no partition-kernel class.
body.justification: A concrete cyclic witness establishes that the characterization enlarges the operational design space.
body.gap: Puelz et al. (2022) and Zhang and Zhao (2023) build partition or biclique kernels and do not exhibit this overlapping-row class.
body.consumer: The strict witness motivates searching beyond biclique partitions whenever legal support contains directed cycles.
